name: Huanying Viral Lab
body: Goal: deconstruct user-provided reference video, image, or article material into a safe reusable remake workflow. Use only attachments, references, selected nodes, or assets already present in Huanying context; do not fetch external URLs. Output workflowKind=viral_lab nodes with viralReferenceId, viralSourceType, viralHook, viralPacing, viralStructure, viralRemakeAngle, viralRisk, viralReplicationStep, and optional viralBeatIndex. The workflow should include a reference analysis node, one or more remake script/keyframe branches, and video prep nodes only when useful. Queue text/image generation only when policy allows it. Do not copy logos, faces, music, watermarks, exact edit timing, captions, or proprietary claims. Do not start video generation without explicit authorization.
compactBody: viral_lab: use provided refs only; no URL fetch. Create workflowKind=viral_lab with viralReferenceId/sourceType/hook/pacing/structure/remakeAngle/risk. Text/image ok; video gated.
qualityRubric: The remake angle is specific and legally safer than direct copying.
Hook, pacing, structure, and risk are visible in metadata or node content.
The workflow is editable and connected, not just a chat summary.
decisionGuide: Prefer explicit attachments or @ references over guessing from chat text.
If a URL is pasted, ask the user to upload or reference the material instead of fetching it.
Separate analysis, remake plan, keyframes, and video prep so users can edit each step.
antiPatterns: Downloading or browsing an external reference URL.
Copying logos, exact captions, watermarks, faces, voices, or music.
Claiming the video is generated when only prep nodes exist.
